"""Publish one exact independently reviewed normalized-upgrade manifest to PR6."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys

ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
BASE='d6d590aa0b46df0521127ef114d27deb101b0561'
MANIFEST=Path('.superpowers/m80-normalized-upgrade-publication-manifest.json')
REVIEW=Path('evaluations/research-qa/m80-normalized-upgrade-publication-independent-20260925-review.json')
INTENT=Path('.superpowers/m80-normalized-upgrade-publication-intent.json')
RECEIPT=Path('.superpowers/m80-normalized-upgrade-published.json')
PATHSPEC=Path('.superpowers/m80-normalized-upgrade-publication-paths.nul')

def require(condition,message):
    if not condition: raise RuntimeError(message)
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','gc.auto=0',*args])
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def exclusive(p,value):
    with p.open('xb') as f:
        f.write((json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n').encode()); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())

def main():
    manifest_sha,review_sha=sys.argv[1:]
    require(not any(p.exists() for p in [INTENT,RECEIPT,PATHSPEC]),'Existing attempt: inspect, never replay')
    require(sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes())==manifest_sha and sha(REVIEW.read_bytes())==review_sha,'Review or manifest changed')
    m=json.loads(MANIFEST.read_bytes()); r=json.loads(REVIEW.read_bytes())
    require(m['base_commit']==BASE and m['profile']=='m80.normalized-upgrade-publication-manifest.v1','Wrong manifest')
    require(r['reviewer']=='/root/m80_foundation_runtime_qa' and r['verdict']=='pass_exact_normalized_upgrade_publication_manifest_only','Missing independent acceptance')
    require(r['manifest']=={'path':MANIFEST.as_posix(),'sha256':manifest_sha},'Wrong reviewed manifest')
    require(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==BASE,'Head changed')
    require(git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='codex/corporate-mvp','Wrong branch')
    require(git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp').decode().split()[0]==BASE,'Remote changed')
    require(not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip(),'Unrelated staged work')
    paths=[f['path'] for f in m['files']]
    require(len(paths)==len(set(paths))==m['file_count'] and len(paths)>0,'Invalid path inventory')
    for item in m['files']:
        p=Path(item['path'])
        require(not p.is_absolute() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT),'Path outside repository')
        require(p.as_posix()=='.gitattributes' or p.parts[0] in ('docs','evaluations','operations'),'Unexpected public path')
        require(not any(part.startswith('.') and part!='.gitattributes' for part in p.parts),'Private path')
        data=p.read_bytes()
        require(len(data)==item['bytes'] and sha(data)==item['sha256'],'Changed publication bytes: '+str(p))
    subprocess.run(['python','tools/agent_ops.py','validate'],check=True)
    exclusive(INTENT,{'base':BASE,'manifest_sha256':manifest_sha,'review_sha256':review_sha,'no_automatic_replay':True})
    with PATHSPEC.open('xb') as f:
        f.write(b'\0'.join(p.encode() for p in paths)+b'\0');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
    git('add','--pathspec-from-file='+str(PATHSPEC),'--pathspec-file-nul')
    require(set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==set(paths),'Unexpected staged delta')
    for item in m['files']: require(sha(git('show',':'+item['path']))==item['sha256'],'Staged bytes changed')
    git('diff','--cached','--check')
    git('commit','-m','Verify Scope 1 backup normalization and upgrade preparation')
    head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
    require(git('rev-parse','HEAD^').decode().strip()==BASE,'Wrong publication parent')
    require(set(git('diff-tree','--no-commit-id','--name-only','-r',head).decode().splitlines())==set(paths),'Unexpected committed delta')
    for item in m['files']: require(sha(git('show',head+':'+item['path']))==item['sha256'],'Committed bytes changed')
    git('push','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp')
    remote=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/codex/corporate-mvp').decode().split()[0]
    require(remote==head,'Remote publication unconfirmed')
    exclusive(RECEIPT,{'head':head,'remote':remote,'manifest_sha256':manifest_sha,'review_sha256':review_sha,'pr':'https://github.com/neuvetra-hq/neuvetra/pull/6','checks':'pending','hosted_mutation':False})
    print(json.dumps({'status':'published_reviewed_normalized_upgrade','head':head,'files':len(paths),'checks':'pending'}))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
